description: §12.2 Trigger 3 non-regression pin for §6.6.19 — the same `scrml:auth` member reached from a plain `function` still SERVER-ESCALATES and compiles clean. The derived-position refusal must not disturb the function path S299 closed, and this is the shape the E-DERIVED-SERVER-ONLY-REACH message tells the author to move to.
rationale: §12.2 Trigger 3: 'calling a binding imported from any of them escalates the function that calls it'. A function HAS a placement to change, so escalation is available and is the right answer — unlike the derived position (§6.6.19), where a synchronous lazy-pull recompute (§6.6.3) cannot become a round trip. Measured S331: this shape emits `.server.js`, and `hashPassword` appears 0 times in the client bundle and `Bun.password` 0 times in the shipped runtime, against 4 for the un-escalated derived shape.
